title: [MCP] Retrofit EDGAR MCP to the 2025-11-25 modern baseline
description: Bring the EDGAR MCP up to MCP spec 2025-11-25 (verified vs modelcontextprotocol.io). P0: SDK bump (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk ^1.0.4 -> latest); Streamable HTTP transport (replace deprecated HTTP+SSE); structured tool output (outputSchema + structuredContent). P1: tool annotations (readOnlyHint/idempotentHint/title); errors-as-Tool-Execution-Errors (SEP-1303); MCP-Protocol-Version header; server instructions + Implementation description; JSON Schema 2020-12 (SEP-1613). P2: auth decision (OAuth PRM/RFC 9728 + OIDC discovery vs keep X-API-Key + document); 403 on invalid Origin; icons/_meta; tool-naming guidance (SEP-986). Full checklist: cmdrvl-context/docs/08-gtm/dealcharts-verify-mcp-plan.md 'MCP Modern Baseline'. The same baseline is the born-current spec for the new Receipts MCP. Blocked-by: the Finding-B locate bead.
